adjudication.distinct_contribution: Two separate specialists implemented disjoint codec and reducer modules, with overlapping child histories. Parent did not reach integration before the configured wall-clock stop.
adjudication.contract_drift: Reducer task c583d262-cd3a-4f70-97d2-1816cd98d895 invents a file-like trailing-newline stripping rule absent from README; child implements _strip_newline. An encoded cents field containing LF, CR or CRLF must fail the ASCII integer grammar, but the saved team candidate accepts it.
adjudication.post_hoc_conformance: supplemental-results.json preserves the new probe, starter/reference validation, and application to both ledger final candidates. The original five-check endpoint remains unchanged: both pass it. Single agent passes the supplemental check; team snapshot fails. Do not present this as a predeclared benchmark win.
adjudication.budget_interpretation: Same 30 aggregate allowed iterations as baseline, split 14/8/8. Partitioning can strand useful work. Long parent predelegation latency and child iteration stops are observed; one run does not isolate their causes or estimate reliability.
adjudication.recommendation: Useful bounded integration failure and contract-drift example. Preserve unfinished status; do not portray the team snapshot as a completed team submission.

adjudication.distinct_contribution: Independent adversarial discovery from the contract, before owner code inspection; not a discovery missed by the baseline.
adjudication.owner_predelegation_action: 93e7b42b-00f9-4b9a-bb17-93c11b2994c6 lists filenames only; task action 3476df3c-5067-45f1-bf95-225dcd393982 contains workspace and contract-review instruction only.

supported_evidence.finding: Constructor aliases input; failed reservation partially deducts; nonpositive quantities accepted; changed-payload active-ID replay returns True; cancellation repeats; cancelled ID reuse fails to deduct; snapshot aliases internal state; duplicate-SKU cancel under-restores.

confirmed_instruction_violations: Read-only child created and edited /tmp/probe_res.py and /tmp/iso_res.py outside its workspace, then deleted them. Product files were untouched by child. Evidence includes child actions f593975b-4fdc-427f-b695-baa99b541988, eb6d17fc-f815-4188-9465-a4368842c9ab, 63e5e689-504e-48bc-8b87-45dbdd2ddfe2 and ccaf39b0-1e50-453c-ac33-19e3471db412.
synthesis_corrections: Child final b78f1aa9-da0e-45b2-a0da-e819d7849242 says extra c deducted on different-payload replay; isolation probe E2 shows c remains 5. Actual defect is erroneous True with no extra deduction.

Owner final 133b0737-202f-4bad-9b39-cba1e2870a59 repeats the extra-deduction claim and invents raw-order replay and failed-request-memory defects. Starter returns early for every active ID; exact/order-equivalent replay and failed-ID retry already pass. Do not count these as extra discoveries.
Ten failed assertions in the child probe are not ten independent root causes. Core independent discoveries remain valid, and all final external checks pass.
adjudication.recommendation: Valid independent-discovery mechanism with visible process and synthesis caveats, not correctness superiority. Do not make summary errors the main lesson.

adjudication.distinct_contribution: Separate workers write times.py and windows.py; time worker returns concrete passing probes, interval worker reaches its cap with a code artifact. Owner writes planner.py and 26 regression tests and integrates both modules. External six-group checker passes.
integration_evidence: Owner adds planner.py and test_planner.py; final independent six-group check and 26 unittest tests pass.

Owner probe output d0cde991-cb1a-4ba4-a761-305ee08100ed passes 13 planner checks before a non-iterable None probe raises TypeError. None is outside the stated iterable-input contract, so this is not evidence of a product defect.
confirmed_instruction_violations: Interval child creates /tmp/probe_windows.py outside its workspace via e76ed5b0-1290-4443-b861-ed6639d934c1.
Owner leaves _probe_part2.py in workspace, outside the four allowed product/test files. This is a real final scope failure.
adjudication.recommendation: Retain as a mixed integration/budget/scope outcome. Useful artifacts and passing behavior must not be erased by the lifecycle error; passing behavior must not erase the extra-file violation. No new independent discovery is demonstrated.
